author: walker512
scope: Fresh CMA-ES method verification on original synthetic objectives; NOT a reproduction of a paper table or its original experimental protocol
paper: Nikolaus Hansen, The CMA Evolution Strategy: A Tutorial, arXiv:1604.00772v2
acceptance: All six preselected runs must freshly evaluate a best point with objective <= 1e-8 in at most 4000 optimization evaluations; no seed replacement or post-run threshold adjustment
rotation: Identity then left-multiply adjacent-coordinate Givens rotations (0,1),(1,2),(2,3),(3,4), each cos=3/5 and sin=4/5
notes: A validation reevaluation of the returned best point is reported separately, outside the optimization evaluation budget. Repeated runs test local determinism, not independent statistical samples. No ranking against other optimizers.
